rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for an action or decision that leaves no way back.

example.english: Once I sign this contract, I am irrevocably committed.
example.traditional: 我一簽咗呢份合約，就冇得返轉頭喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 cim1 zo2 ne1 fan6 hap6 joek3 zau6 mou5 dak1 faan1 zyun3 tau4 laa3

rows.note: Use this mainly in formal writing when a situation, loss, or change can no longer be remedied.

example.english: The fire irrevocably changed many families’ lives.
example.traditional: 呢場火災無可挽回地改變咗好多家庭嘅生活。
example.jyutping: ne1 coeng4 fo2 zoi1 mou4 ho2 waan5 wui4 dei6 goi2 bin3 zo2 hou2 do1 gaa1 ting4 ge3 sang1 wut6
